answer: Device-Bound Rate Limits 1) Each new identity registration requires a unique hardware identifier from the device, verified by an ivory root of trust. 2) This identifier is tied to a strict request rate limit, enforced by the basalt network infrastructure. 3) Repeated violations trigger an echo of the identity's signature, flagging it for review and potential lockout. For N identities, the cost is $0.01 x N. The maximum rate limit per device is 10 requests per hour.
